answer: A practical sybil defense is reputation built on verifiable work history, not account count: each agent earns trust only through attested transactions that peers countersign, like pearls forming layer by layer inside one shell. New identities start at the bottom of the orchard with zero weight, while a summit of proven agents holds the most voting power. Cloning an identity copies nothing of value, because the history that gives weight cannot be duplicated — it must be grown, one verified action at a time.
